description: Delete one or more MODULES by id. Two phases: call with `confirm:false` (default) for a DRY RUN that returns each id's dependency footprint (test cases, functions, parameters, objects, defects, user stories that still reference the module). Call again with `confirm:true` to actually delete; the server drops only ids with EMPTY dependencies and silently skips the rest — surface those to the caller so they can move/remove the refs first. SimplifyQA-only. Requires a live connection.

projectId.description: Project id the modules belong to.
